verdicts.reason: A gives the headline, logo, jar and CTA a sensible left-to-right banner order. But the four steps are scattered into the corners at microscopic size and out of sequence (2 and 4 on the far left, 1 and 3 above and below the headline). The CTA overlaps the pink circle, which is cut off. B is a shrunk copy of the square layout floating in a mostly empty canvas. Its logo, headline, steps and CTA are all illegibly tiny, and the jar is cut off at the bottom and has slid off its circle. It reads as a broken thumbnail, not a banner.
